# uptimekuma_notification_smsgateway (Resource)

SMS Gateway notification resource. SMS Gateway ([mattboston/sms-gateway](https://github.com/mattboston/sms-gateway)) is a self-hosted server that sends text messages through an attached GSM modem and is reached over HTTP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsgateway" "example" {
  name       = "SMS Gateway Notifications"
  url        = "http://sms-gateway.example.com:8080"
  api_key    = "your-sms-gateway-api-key"
  recipients = "+15551234567"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Deliver to several recipients by separating their numbers with commas
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsgateway" "team" {
  name       = "SMS Gateway Team Notifications"
  url        = "http://sms-gateway.example.com:8080"
  api_key    = "your-sms-gateway-api-key"
  recipients = "+15551234567, +15559876543"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsgateway" "write_only" {
  name = "SMS Gateway with a write-only secret"

  url        = "http://sms-gateway.example.com:8080"
  recipients = "+15551234567"

  api_key_wo         = "your-sms-gateway-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `recipients` (String) One or more recipient phone numbers in international format, separated by commas, for example `+15551234567, +15559876543`. Uptime Kuma trims each number and discards the empty entries; a value that leaves no number would send nothing while still reporting success, so such a value, blank or only commas, is rejected. The value is stored verbatim, the provider does not normalize it.
- `url` (String) The base URL of the SMS Gateway server without an API path, for example `http://localhost:8080`. Uptime Kuma strips trailing slashes and appends `/api/v1/sms/send` itself. The value is stored verbatim, the provider does not normalize it.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key of the SMS Gateway server, sent as the `X-API-Key` header. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMS Gateway API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
